big: Nifty NBFC is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty NBFC track?
Nifty NBFC Index aims to track the performance of all the Non-Banking Financial Company stocks from the Nifty Total Market Index. It holds 21 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
